# PadelWrist

> PadelWrist is a padel scoring app for Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad, and publishes a practical padel knowledge base covering rules, scoring, court play, tactics, equipment and common player questions.

Last updated: 2026-08-18.

PadelWrist supports standard padel scoring with games, sets and tie-breaks, Fixed Points scoring, server tracking, spoken score announcements, undo and score correction, saved players, match history, historic result editing and resuming unfinished matches. It does not require an account.

Apple Watch is the primary wrist-first scoring surface. iPhone and iPad provide larger-screen setup, scoring and match-management experiences. Active scoring is local-first, so a temporary device connection loss does not stop the scoring device. Apple Watch does not communicate directly with iPad through WatchConnectivity; where both participate in the same match, the paired iPhone provides the relay path.

PadelWrist does not currently organise Americano or Mexicano tournaments, rotate partners, generate pairings or standings, provide social networking or cloud accounts, or claim Apple Health and heart-rate features.

Rules-based knowledge-base articles use the International Padel Federation as the primary official source and show review dates where current rule status matters. Social formats are described as common formats because organiser rules vary.

Contact: support@padelwrist.com

## Product

- [PadelWrist website](https://padelwrist.com/): Product overview for the Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad padel scoring app.
- [Padel score tracker](https://padelwrist.com/padel-score-tracker/): Points, games, sets, tie-breaks, server state and match history across Apple devices.
- [Apple Watch padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/apple-watch-padel-scoring/): Wrist-first scoring, spoken scores, server tracking, undo and local-first behaviour.
- [Padel match history](https://padelwrist.com/padel-match-history/): Local match history, editing saved results, resuming unfinished matches and deletion.

## Start here

- [Padel knowledge base](https://padelwrist.com/guides/): The main index for PadelWrist's padel reference content.
- [What is padel?](https://padelwrist.com/what-is-padel/): Beginner introduction to the court, walls, scoring, serve and equipment.
- [Padel rules 2026](https://padelwrist.com/padel-rules/): Serving, walls, volleys, faults, scoring and 2026 Star Point context.
- [Padel court dimensions](https://padelwrist.com/padel-court-dimensions/): Standard 20m x 10m court, enclosure, service boxes and layout.
- [Padel vs tennis](https://padelwrist.com/padel-vs-tennis/): Court, racket, serve, walls, tactics and beginner accessibility compared.
- [Padel equipment for beginners](https://padelwrist.com/padel-equipment-for-beginners/): Racket, balls, shoes, clothing, overgrips and what to hire first.
- [Can you play padel singles?](https://padelwrist.com/can-you-play-padel-singles/): Official doubles format, singles courts and informal 1v1 play.
- [How long does a padel match last?](https://padelwrist.com/how-long-does-a-padel-match-last/): Typical duration, booking time and factors that lengthen matches.

## Rules and scoring

- [How padel scoring works](https://padelwrist.com/how-padel-scoring-works/): 15-30-40, games, sets, advantage, Golden Point, Star Point and tie-breaks.
- [How to keep score in padel](https://padelwrist.com/how-to-keep-score-in-padel/): Practical match scorekeeping, server tracking and avoiding disputes.
- [Padel tie-break rules](https://padelwrist.com/padel-tie-break-rules/): Seven-point tie-break scoring, two-point margin and serving order.
- [Golden Point vs advantage vs Star Point](https://padelwrist.com/golden-point-vs-advantage/): The three deuce approaches and 2026 FIP context.
- [Padel service rules](https://padelwrist.com/padel-service-rules/): Underarm serve, bounce, waist height, diagonal boxes and second serve.
- [Padel wall rules](https://padelwrist.com/padel-wall-rules/): Legal glass and fence rebounds, own-wall play and common mistakes.
- [Padel scoring formats](https://padelwrist.com/padel-scoring-formats/): Advantage, deciding points, Star Point, tie-breaks, mini sets and Fixed Points.
- [Fixed Points padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/fixed-points-padel-scoring/): Rally-point scoring for point-based matches.
- [Americano padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/americano-padel-scoring/): Common fixed-point rounds, partner rotations and individual totals.
- [Mexicano padel scoring](https://padelwrist.com/mexicano-padel-scoring/): Ranking-influenced pairings, rounds and individual totals.

## Playing and tactics

- [Padel positioning for beginners](https://padelwrist.com/padel-positioning-for-beginners/): Defending, net position, moving as a pair, lobs and transition.
- [Padel shots guide](https://padelwrist.com/padel-shots-guide/): Volley, lob, bandeja, víbora, chiquita, bajada and smash.
- [Padel glossary](https://padelwrist.com/padel-glossary/): More than 50 scoring, court, shot, tactical, equipment and format terms.
